# desc

> Parse DESCRIPTION files

Parse, manipulate and reformat DESCRIPTION files. The package provides
two APIs, one is object oriented, the other one is procedural and
manipulates the files *in place*.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

- [Installation](#installation)
- [The object oriented API](#the-oo-api)
  - [Introduction](#introduction)
  - [Loading or creating new `DESCRIPTION`
    files](#loading-or-creating-new-description-files)
  - [Normalizing `DESCRIPTION` files](#normalizing-description-files)

    fields](#querying-changing-and-removing-fields)

## Installation

``` r

# Install the released version from CRAN
install.packages("desc")

# Or the development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("r-lib/desc")
```

## The object oriented API

``` r

library(desc)
```

### Introduction

The object oriented API uses [R6](https://github.com/r-lib/R6) classes.

### Loading or creating new `DESCRIPTION` files

A new `description` object can be created by reading a `DESCRIPTION`
file form the disk. By default the `DESCRIPTION` file in the current
directory is read:

``` r

desc <- description$new()
```

``` r

desc
```

``` R
#> Package: desc
#> Title: Manipulate DESCRIPTION Files
#> Version: 1.0.0
#> Author: Gábor Csárdi
#> Maintainer: Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com>
#> Description: Tools to read, write, create, and manipulate DESCRIPTION
#>     files.  It is intented for packages that create or manipulate other
#>     packages.
#> License: MIT + file LICENSE
#> URL: https://github.com/r-lib/desc
#> BugReports: https://github.com/r-lib/desc/issues
#> Imports:
#>     R6
#> Suggests:
#>     newpackage,
#>     testthat,
#>     whoami
#> Encoding: UTF-8
#> LazyData: true
#> RoxygenNote: 5.0.0
```

A new object can also be created from scratch:

``` r

desc2 <- description$new("!new")
desc2
```

``` R
#> Package: {{ Package }}
#> Title: {{ Title }}
#> Version: 1.0.0
#> Authors@R (parsed):
#>     * Jo Doe <jodoe@dom.ain> [aut, cre]
#> Maintainer: {{ Maintainer }}
#> Description: {{ Description }}
#> License: {{ License }}
#> URL: {{ URL }}
#> BugReports: {{ BugReports }}
#> Encoding: UTF-8
```

### Normalizing `DESCRIPTION` files

Most `DESCRIPTION` fields may be formatted in multiple equivalent ways.
`desc` does not reformat fields, unless they are updated or reformatting
is explicitly requested via a call to the `normalize()` method or using
the `normalize` argument of the
[`write()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/write.html) method.

### Querying, changing and removing fields

[`get()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/get.html) and `set()` queries or
updates a field:

``` r

desc$set("Package", "foo")
desc$get("Package")
```

``` R
#> Package 
#>   "foo"
```

They work with multiple fields as well:

``` r

desc$set(Package = "bar", Title = "Bar Package")
desc$get(c("Package", "Title"))
```

``` R
#>       Package         Title 
#>         "bar" "Bar Package"
```

### Dependencies

Package dependencies can be set and updated via an easier API:

``` r

desc$get_deps()
```

``` R
#>       type    package version
#> 1 Suggests   testthat       *
#> 2 Suggests     whoami       *
#> 3 Suggests newpackage       *
#> 4  Imports         R6       *
```

``` r

desc$set_dep("mvtnorm")
desc$set_dep("Rcpp", "LinkingTo")
desc$get_deps()
```

``` R
#>        type    package version
#> 1  Suggests   testthat       *
#> 2  Suggests     whoami       *
#> 3  Suggests newpackage       *
#> 4   Imports    mvtnorm       *
#> 5   Imports         R6       *
#> 6 LinkingTo       Rcpp       *
```

``` r

desc
```

``` R
#> Package: bar
#> Title: Bar Package
#> Version: 1.0.0
#> Author: Gábor Csárdi
#> Maintainer: Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com>
#> Description: Tools to read, write, create, and manipulate DESCRIPTION
#>     files.  It is intented for packages that create or manipulate other
#>     packages.
#> License: MIT + file LICENSE
#> URL: https://github.com/r-lib/desc
#> BugReports: https://github.com/r-lib/desc/issues
#> Imports:
#>     mvtnorm,
#>     R6
#> Suggests:
#>     newpackage,
#>     testthat,
#>     whoami
#> LinkingTo:
#>     Rcpp
#> Encoding: UTF-8
#> LazyData: true
#> RoxygenNote: 5.0.0
```

### Collate fields

Collate fields can be queried and set using simple character vectors of
file names:

``` r

desc$set_collate(list.files("../R"))
```

``` R
#> Warning in idesc_set_collate(self, private, files, match.arg(which)): No files
#> in 'Collate' field
```

``` r

desc$get_collate()
```

``` R
#> character(0)
```

### Authors

Authors information, when specified via the `Authors@R` field, also has
a simplified API:

``` r

desc <- description$new("tools/pkg2")
desc$get_authors()
```

``` R
#> [1] "Hadley Wickham <h.wickham@gmail.com> [aut, cre, cph]"
#> [2] "Peter Danenberg <pcd@roxygen.org> [aut, cph]"        
#> [3] "Manuel Eugster [aut, cph]"                           
#> [4] "RStudio [cph]"
```

``` r

desc$add_author("Bugs", "Bunny", email = "bb@acme.com")
desc$add_me()
desc$add_author_gh("jeroen")
desc$get_authors()
```

``` R
#> [1] "Hadley Wickham <h.wickham@gmail.com> [aut, cre, cph]"
#> [2] "Peter Danenberg <pcd@roxygen.org> [aut, cph]"        
#> [3] "Manuel Eugster [aut, cph]"                           
#> [4] "RStudio [cph]"                                       
#> [5] "Bugs Bunny <bb@acme.com>"                            
#> [6] "First Last <first.last@dom.com> [ctb]"               
#> [7] "Jeroen Ooms <jeroen@berkeley.edu> [ctb]"
```

If the `Author` field is specified, it can be changed to a `Authors@R`
field using `coerce_authors_at_r()`, incorporating the `Maintainer`
information if necessary:

``` r

desc <- description$new("!new")
desc$del("Authors@R")
desc$del("Maintainer")
desc$set(Author = "Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com>")
desc$get_authors()
```

``` R
#> Error in ensure_authors_at_r(self): No 'Authors@R' field!
#> You can create one with $add_author.
#> You can also use $coerce_authors_at_r() to change Author fields
```

``` r

desc$coerce_authors_at_r()
desc$get_authors()
```

``` R
#> [1] "Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com> [aut]"
```

## The procedural API

The procedural API is simpler to use for one-off `DESCRIPTION`
manipulation, since it does not require dealing with `description`
objects. Each object oriented method has a procedural counterpart that
works on a file, and potentially writes its result back to the same
file.

For example, adding a new dependency to `DESCRIPTION` in the current
working directory can be done with

``` r

desc_set_dep("newpackage", "Suggests")
```

``` R
#> Package: desc
#> Title: Manipulate DESCRIPTION Files
#> Version: 1.4.3.9000
#> Authors@R (parsed):
#>     * Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com> [aut, cre]
#>     * Kirill Müller [aut]
#>     * Jim Hester <james.f.hester@gmail.com> [aut]
#>     * Maëlle Salmon [ctb] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2815-0399>)
#>     * Posit Software, PBC [cph, fnd] (ROR: <https://ror.org/03wc8by49>)
#> Maintainer: Gábor Csárdi <csardi.gabor@gmail.com>
#> Description: Tools to read, write, create, and manipulate DESCRIPTION
#>     files.  It is intended for packages that create or manipulate other
#>     packages.
#> License: MIT + file LICENSE
#> URL: https://desc.r-lib.org/, https://github.com/r-lib/desc
#> BugReports: https://github.com/r-lib/desc/issues
#> Depends:
#>     R (>= 3.4)
#> Imports:
#>     cli,
#>     R6,
#>     utils
#> Suggests:
#>     callr,
#>     covr,
#>     gh,
#>     newpackage,
#>     spelling,
#>     testthat,
#>     whoami,
#>     withr
#> Config/Needs/website: tidyverse/tidytemplate
#> Config/testthat/edition: 3
#> Config/usethis/last-upkeep: 2025-04-23
#> Encoding: UTF-8
#> Language: en-US
#> Roxygen: list(r6 = FALSE, load = "installed", markdown = TRUE)
#> RoxygenNote: 7.3.2.9000
#> Collate:
#>     'assertions.R'
#>     'authors-at-r.R'
#>     'built.R'
#>     'classes.R'
#>     'collate.R'
#>     'constants.R'
#>     'deps.R'
#>     'desc-package.R'
#>     'description.R'
#>     'encoding.R'
#>     'find-package-root.R'
#>     'latex.R'
#>     'non-oo-api.R'
#>     'package-archives.R'
#>     'read.R'
#>     'remotes.R'
#>     'str.R'
#>     'syntax_checks.R'
#>     'urls.R'
#>     'utils.R'
#>     'validate.R'
#>     'version.R'
```

This added `newpackage` to the `Suggests` field:

``` r

desc_get("Suggests")
```

``` R
#>                                                                                                  Suggests 
#> "\n    callr,\n    covr,\n    gh,\n    newpackage,\n    spelling,\n    testthat,\n    whoami,\n    withr"
```

So the full list of dependencies are now

``` r

desc_get_deps()
```

``` R
#>        type    package version
#> 1   Depends          R  >= 3.4
#> 2   Imports        cli       *
#> 3   Imports         R6       *
#> 4   Imports      utils       *
#> 5  Suggests      callr       *
#> 6  Suggests       covr       *
#> 7  Suggests         gh       *
#> 8  Suggests newpackage       *
#> 9  Suggests   spelling       *
#> 10 Suggests   testthat       *
#> 11 Suggests     whoami       *
#> 12 Suggests      withr       *
```

contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Object Oriented R6 API

- [`description`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/description.md) :
  Read, write, update, validate DESCRIPTION files

## Precedural API

- [`desc()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc.md) : Read a
  DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_add_author()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_author.md)
  : Add an author to Authors@R in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_author_gh()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_author_gh.md)
  : Add a GitHub user as an author to DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_me()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_me.md)
  : Add the current user as an author to DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_orcid()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_orcid.md)
  : Add an ORCID to one or more authors in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_remotes()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_remotes.md)
  : Add locations in the Remotes field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_role()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_role.md)
  : Add a role to one or more authors in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_ror()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_ror.md)
  : Add an ROR to one or more authors in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_to_collate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_to_collate.md)
  : Add one or more files to the Collate field, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_add_urls()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_add_urls.md)
  : Add URLs to the URL field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_bump_version()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_bump_version.md)
  : Increase the version number in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_change_maintainer()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_change_maintainer.md)
  : Change maintainer of the package, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_clear_remotes()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_clear_remotes.md)
  : Remove all locations from the Remotes field of DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_clear_urls()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_clear_urls.md)
  : Remove all URLs from the URL field of DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_coerce_authors_at_r()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_coerce_authors_at_r.md)
  : Coerce Author and Maintainer Fields to Authors@R
- [`desc_del()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del.md) :
  Remove fields from a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_del_author()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_author.md)
  : Remove one or more authors from DESCRIPTION.
- [`desc_del_collate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_collate.md)
  : Delete the Collate field from DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_del_dep()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_dep.md)
  : Remove a package dependency from DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_del_deps()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_deps.md)
  : Remove all dependencies from DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_del_from_collate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_from_collate.md)
  : Remove files from the Collate field.
- [`desc_del_remotes()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_remotes.md)
  : Delete locations from the Remotes field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_del_role()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_role.md)
  : Delete a role of an author, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_del_urls()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_del_urls.md)
  : Delete URLs from the URL field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_fields()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_fields.md)
  : List all fields in a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_get()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get.md) : Get
  a field from a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_get_author()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_author.md)
  : Query authors by role in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_authors()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_authors.md)
  : Query all authors in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_built()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_built.md)
  : Query the built field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_collate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_collate.md)
  : Query the Collate field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_deps()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_deps.md)
  : List all package dependencies from a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_get_field()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_field.md)
  [`desc_get_or_fail()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_field.md)
  [`desc_get_list()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_field.md)
  : Get a single field from a DESCRIPTION file, fail if not found
- [`desc_get_maintainer()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_maintainer.md)
  : Query the package maintainer in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_remotes()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_remotes.md)
  : List the locations in the Remotes field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_urls()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_urls.md)
  : Query the URL field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_get_version()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_get_version.md)
  : Query the package version in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_has_dep()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_has_dep.md)
  : Check for a dependency
- [`desc_has_fields()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_has_fields.md)
  : Check if some fields are present in a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_normalize()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_normalize.md)
  : Normalize a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_print()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_print.md) :
  Print the contents of a DESCRIPTION file to the screen
- [`desc_reformat_fields()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_reformat_fields.md)
  : Reformat fields in a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_reorder_fields()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_reorder_fields.md)
  : Reorder fields in a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_set()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set.md)
  [`desc_set_list()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set.md)
  : Set one or more fields in a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_set_authors()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_authors.md)
  : Set authors in Authors@R, in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_set_collate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_collate.md)
  : Set the Collate field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_set_dep()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_dep.md)
  : Add a package dependency to a DESCRIPTION file
- [`desc_set_deps()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_deps.md)
  : Set all package dependencies in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_set_remotes()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_remotes.md)
  : Set the Remotes field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_set_urls()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_urls.md)
  : Set the URL field in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_set_version()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_set_version.md)
  : Set the package version in DESCRIPTION
- [`desc_to_latex()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_to_latex.md)
  : Converts a DESCRIPTION file to LaTeX
- [`desc_validate()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/desc_validate.md)
  : Validate a DESCRIPTION file
- [`description`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/description.md) :
  Read, write, update, validate DESCRIPTION files

## Utilities and Metadata

- [`check_field()`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/check_field.md)
  : Syntactical check of a DESCRIPTION field
- [`cran_ascii_fields`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/cran_ascii_fields.md)
  : The DESCRIPTION fields that are supposed to be in plain ASCII
  encoding
- [`cran_valid_fields`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/cran_valid_fields.md)
  : A list of DESCRIPTION fields that are valid according to the CRAN
  checks
- [`dep_types`](https://desc.r-lib.org/dev/reference/dep_types.md) :
  DESCRIPTION fields that denote package dependencies
